lines.text: GPS says: Arrived. Nobody lives here.
lines.say: G.P.S. says: arrived. Nobody lives here.

lines.text: I pulled over. My hazards clicking in the dark.
Then headlights. The old pickup rolled in behind me.
It stopped ten feet away. Nobody inside.
I opened my dashcam to prove I wasn't crazy.
lines.say: I opened my dash cam to prove I wasn't crazy.

lines.text: The footage showed no pickup. Not once.
But the first frame showed a car ahead. Mine.
Then my radio crackled. A news report.
November 17th, 1987. A car vanished on Route 9.
lines.say: November seventeenth, nineteen eighty-seven. A car vanished on Route nine.

lines.text: Last seen at 7:13 PM. Driver never found.
lines.say: Last seen at seven thirteen P.M. Driver never found.

lines.text: They described his jacket. Blue. Like mine.
Behind me, the pickup's door creaked open.
Someone stepped out. And called my name.
